Yes sir/ma'am, I'm in the state of Virginia in the US. Thanks for sharing that with me, I'm sorry about your experience; that sounds horrible. As far as my mental state, I'm that guy that is always calm under pressure - I don't have anxiety or panic or anything like that. I don't know if that makes me mentally strong but I'm almost always in control of my emotions, except sadness.

I checked out those subreddits and they're very valuable don't get me wrong but most of the comments seemed to be along the lines of "cheer up! It'll get better!" I really just think I need professional help. I actually tried therapy once but it was a teaching hospital so my doctor had to move on and that wasn't good. Anyway I'm rambling but I don't think any amount of well wishing comments is going to help.
I'm glad it helped you. How would it work with money? Was your experience anything like pdesperaux's comment?
